collection.title: Hyundai Tucson 2004 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Hyundai Tucson 2004 to 2010 model requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Tucson which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
